//: Coverage config for the backend (functions/) node suite, driven by `npm run functions:coverage` (c8 wrapping scripts/run-functions-tests.mjs). The frontend (src/) is measured separately by Vitest — see vitest.config.js, which excludes functions/. `all: true` instruments every functions/ source file, including ones never loaded by a test (e.g. the onCall/onRequest handlers in index.js), so the number reflects the true backend gap rather than only the files a test happened to require. Thresholds are a RATCHET set just under the current baseline: raise them as backend coverage improves so it can only go up.
//baseline: Measured baseline 2026-07-21: lines/statements 47.6%, branches 77.59%, functions 76.77% (154 backend test files). Thresholds sit a small buffer under that so the gate can only ratchet up; bump them again the next time coverage rises.
